comment.text: KMT2C R56 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; Breast tumors; Head and neck tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: headandneck; Lung tumors. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting KMT2C residue R56 have been observed in uterine tumors, bowel tumors, and lung tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
